title: Opinion of the President or Other Members on Referred Points

content.scenario: A Bench of the National Commission is hearing a consumer dispute, but the members differ in opinion on a point. The point is referred to the President, who needs to give an opinion within a specified timeframe.
content.outcome: The President or other members of the National Commission give an opinion on the referred point or points within a period of one month from the date of such reference, as per Section 47(3) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: What happens when members of a Bench differ in opinion?
How is a referred point decided in the National Commission?
What is the timeframe for giving an opinion on a referred point?
